protocol: hybrid_intrinsic_memory_probe_v1: HybridPLWMTransformerActorCritic trained with the intrinsic-count learning rule (ppo_intrinsic_count_v1, bonus 0.05) through the two-stage curriculum, then evaluated on held-out MemoryS7 worlds with the paired counterfactual swap probe; only worlds solved in both the original and swapped layouts count as memory-driven success; no teacher action, path oracle, seed answer, or reward shaping.
